title: Power Rangers Season 8 Lightspeed Rescue
description: Five extraordinary teens carry on the legacy as the Lightspeed Power Rangers, the newest and most powerful team of champions ever, dedicated to fighting evil and protecting all that is good.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x1
episodes_data.description: Five brave young men and women are recruited by the secret agency Lightspeed Rescue to stop a band of demons from destroying Mariner Bay.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x2
episodes_data.description: The Rangers deploy the Rescue Bird to evacuate people from a burning building while fighting the lava monster Magmavore.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x3
episodes_data.description: Carter struggles with leading the Rangers in battle as he recalls a traumatic event from his childhood.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x4
episodes_data.description: The team rushes to help Kelsey's friend Nancy try to land a space shuttle under attack by Diabolico.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x5
episodes_data.description: Dana is trusted with a special assignment by her father.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x6
episodes_data.description: The Rangers and Vypra battle it out in new advanced vehicles.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x7
episodes_data.description: General McKnight tries to replace the Power Rangers with robotic doubles.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x8
episodes_data.description: Chad faces a dangerous new opponent secretly in league with Vypra.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x9
episodes_data.description: Dana faces double trouble when the bus she's on is hijacked and a monster causes a volcano to erupt in Mariner Bay.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x10
episodes_data.description: The Power Rangers attempt to rescue Miss Fairweather from an erupting volcano.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x11
episodes_data.description: The mysterious Titanium Ranger attacks the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x12
episodes_data.description: Captain Mitchell is reunited with his long-lost son.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x13
episodes_data.description: Ryan does some soul-searching while Diabolico attacks Mariner Bay.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x14
episodes_data.description: Ryan tries to hide his curse from the team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x15
episodes_data.description: Ryan risks life and limb to overcome his curse and help the Rangers battle Diabolico's monsters.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x16
episodes_data.description: Ryan journeys to an ancient tomb to overcome the curse of the cobra once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x17
episodes_data.description: Impus completes his transformation into Olympius, who has captured four Rangers, and infiltrates the Aquabase by posing as them. His plot is uncovered by Carter, who weakens him by throwing him into water, and frees his friends.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x18
episodes_data.description: When a monster sets a power plant ablaze, Captain Mitchell jumps into action and braves the fire to rescue a little girl. The incident reveals to Carter that it was Captain Mitchell who has saved him from a fire many years back when he was a child.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x19
episodes_data.description: The demons perform a ritual to return Queen Bansheera to her bodily form. The Rangers interrupt the ceremony, but only enough to bring back the Queen in a deformed state, for which Olympius swears vengeance. Ryan decides that he will leave the Aquabase to go after the Queen, and promises Dana that he will return.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x20
episodes_data.description: Joel is visiting a young friend, Simon, who invents a telescope to observe outer space. However, Simon discovers that an asteroid is approaching the Earth, which was sent by Olympius to impact Mariner Bay. To stop it, the Rangers initiate the Omega Project, which consists of the Omega Zords - five spacecraft which combine into the Omega Crawler and later the Omega Megazord.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x21
episodes_data.description:
Vypra steals a powerful set of crystals to power a laser which will destroy Mariner Bay. Kelsey teams up with her estranged grandmother to destroy the laser and retrieve the crystals.

This episode was dedicated to Robert L. Manahan, who died on June 30, 2000. He was the voice of Zordon in Mighty Morphin Power Rangers through Power Rangers in Space.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x22
episodes_data.description: A monster named Cyclopter trains with Chad's old sensei, who resents him for becoming a Ranger and not following the true path of a martial artist. The monster uses his training to battle the Rangers, but is defeated by Chad, who makes peace with his former mentor, and recalls his own training.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x23
episodes_data.description: A simulation goes awry when Carter's day repeats itself, and he uses his knowledge of the future, and his new Mobile Armored Vehicle, to prevent the Rangers' deaths at the hands of Olympius, who attempts to use their own Rescuebird against them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x24
episodes_data.description: The Rangers take the Max Solarzord to space to prevent spores which have attached to them from going off and releasing toxins into the atmosphere. Meanwhile, Loki and Vypra resurrect Diabolico after they are betrayed by Olympius.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x25
episodes_data.description: Freezer captures four Rangers, with only Carter left to face him and Olympius. Olympius has his own problems, as Diabolico returns looking for payback. Bansheera keeps Diabolico in check, and sends her son to get Carter, who defeats Freezer and frees his friends with the new Thermo Blaster.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x26
episodes_data.description: Joel becomes jealous when he mistakes Clark, Ms. Fairweather's brother, for her boyfriend. She brought him to the Aquabase to help design the new Mega Battle Armor, which Joel and Chad use to defeat Infinitor. Ms. Fairweather later assures Joel that Clark was just her brother.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x27
episodes_data.description: Jinxer loses an egg containing a powerful monster to a quick witted thief who the Rangers are also after. His plot to hold the egg for ransom backfires when the villains attack him, but he is saved by Kelsey, who discovers the thief to have a heart of gold.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x28
episodes_data.description: Vypra uses Chad's new love interest, a mermaid named Marina, to lure Chad into a trap. When Marina's life is endangered, Chad summons up the strength and courage to defeat Vypra and Loki and rescue her. The two reunite, but only to part ways soon after.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x29
episodes_data.description: Trakeena comes to Mariner Bay, prompting the Lost Galaxy Rangers to team up with the Lightspeed Rescue Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x30
episodes_data.description: The Lost Galaxy and Lightspeed Rescue Rangers join forces to stop Trakeena from destroying Mariner Bay.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x31
episodes_data.description: Dana helps her teammates overcome a case of amnesia.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x32
episodes_data.description: The Rangers are transported into the monster underworld, where they face invincible dead monsters. They escape with the help of the Sorcerer of the Sands, who Ryan has found in the desert in hopes of discovering a way to imprison the demons. Olympius remains trapped in the underworld, and Diabolico kills the sorcerer in a battle of spells.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x33
episodes_data.description: Jinxer manipulates Captain Mitchell into providing Olympius with enough energy to destroy the Rangers after he escapes the underworld. When Ms. Fairweather interrupts the power feed, the star power is destroyed, allowing the Rangers to defeat the demon prince.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x34
episodes_data.description: Marina returns to ask for Chad's help after her father's trident is stolen, which a water demon uses to drain the water from Mariner Bay. Chad recovers the trident, as well as a captive Marina, and safely returns the two to Neptune, the god of the sea.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x35
episodes_data.description: The Arachnor monster traps the Rangers in its web forcing Carter to deploy the Trans Armor Cycle: Mega Armor mode.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x36
episodes_data.description: Dana balances being a glamorous supermodel with her duties as the Pink Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x37
episodes_data.description: Bansheera unleashes her magnificent power on friend and foe alike.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x38
episodes_data.description: Olympius and Diabolico join forces prompting the Rangers to risk using the Lifeforce Megazord powered by their own life energy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x39
episodes_data.description: Jinxer launches a crippling attack on the Aquabase.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue 8x40
episodes_data.description: The Lightspeed Rescue Rangers take their battle against Queen Bansheera into her very lair.
